name: degit-package
description: Import the tip of a source branch into a target repository workspace.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with read access to source and write access to target repository.

SOURCE_ORG.description: Source repository organization or user to import from.

SOURCE_NAME.description: Source repository name to import from.

SOURCE_BRANCH.description: Source branch to import. Defaults to the source repository default branch.

TARGET_SUBDIR.description: Relative subdirectory inside the target repository where content is imported.

EXCLUDE_PATHS.description: Comma-separated paths to exclude during import.

HEAD_BRANCH.description: Branch name to prepare in repository. Auto-generated when empty.

has-changes.description: Whether import produced changes in the target workspace.

degit-branch.description: Branch prepared in the target repository workspace.

degit-workdir.description: Working directory used for the target repository clone.

source-sha.description: Source branch tip SHA used for import.
